scope.component_warning: Components overlap; generation, restore and recomputation are within resume, and export/encode are within pause. Deltas identify recorded overhead, not isolated causal effects.
scope.cross_system_warning: GPU, CUDA wheel, operating system and recorded commit differ. Host CPU/quota/thread settings are not established as matched. Frozen continuation IDs also differ for one case. This is not a pure GPU comparison and no cross-GPU speedup is inferred.
scope.integrity_warning: Each run is independently audited with validator code loaded from its recorded commit. Artifact consistency is not physical-execution attestation.
scope.memory_definition: Host serialized cache payload, CUDA allocator peaks, and sampled RSS are separate metrics. The pressure budget limits retained host payload, not GPU VRAM.
scope.quality_warning: This artifact contains timing-mode action choices only; free-generation choices and answer scoring require their own audit.
scope.statistics_warning: Three repeats reuse 24 generated questions. Balanced mixture is descriptive and not a deployment-weighted claim, significance test, serving throughput, or dollars saved.
scope.timing_definition: Initial prefill + pause + resume wall time or cancellation work, averaged over all started sessions. Equal-work runs force 24 token steps regardless of EOS.

balanced_observed_mix.weighting: Raw total session time / started sessions. Each cell contributes 72 started sessions per policy; ratios are calculated after summing times, not averaged.

notes: More admissions need not produce more hits: replacement records show which retained owners are evicted and whether new owners cancel. These are observed outcomes, not information available to admission in advance.

Roomy CPU encode/decode differences can be compared with the full-session difference. This diagnoses the reference-codec overhead; it does not establish an advantage over simple native admission or optimized GPU quantization.

Initial-prefill and generation timers can differ despite identical logical work. Their deltas and per-repeat results are retained so total-time changes are not attributed entirely to policy decisions.
These are equal-work decisions only. Do not reuse their admissions or hit counts as free-generation quality-run decisions.

validation.scope: independent artifact/accounting/score audit; does not rerun inference or prove performance/quality generalization
